name: Congruence Criterion: Hypotenuse-Leg (HL)
originalDescription: 斜边和一条直角边分别相等的两个直角三角形全等。
description: 斜边和一条直角边分别相等的两个直角三角形全等。
originalCriteria: 能叙述 HL
能判断何时只能用 HL
criteria: State the hypotenuse-leg congruence criterion for two right triangles.
Recognize when the given hypotenuse and leg directly support HL; other criteria may become usable after deriving additional facts.

name: Sum of the Exterior Angles of a Polygon
originalDescription: 任意多边形的外角和为 360°。
description: For a convex polygon, take one exterior angle at every vertex using a consistent turn direction. These exterior angles sum to 360 degrees.
originalCriteria: 能说明外角和为 360°
能用于求正多边形的边数
criteria: Explain that the consistently chosen exterior angles of a convex polygon sum to 360 degrees.
Find the number of sides of a regular convex polygon by dividing 360 degrees by one exterior angle.

name: Zeros of Functions
originalDescription: 知道函数零点就是方程 f(x)=0 的实根，也是图象与 x 轴交点的横坐标。
description: 知道函数零点就是方程 f(x)=0 的实根，也是图象与 x 轴交点的横坐标。
originalCriteria: 能求简单函数的零点
能用函数值变号判断零点所在区间
criteria: Find zeros of simple functions.
For a continuous real function on a closed interval, use opposite endpoint signs to guarantee at least one interior zero; sign change alone does not imply a zero without continuity.

name: Bisection Method
originalDescription: 能用二分法把含根区间缩小一半，并计算中点的函数值。
description: For a continuous real function on a closed interval with opposite nonzero endpoint signs, bisect the interval and evaluate its midpoint. If that value is zero, a root has been found; otherwise retain the half with opposite endpoint signs.
originalCriteria: 能求出区间中点
能根据中点函数值的符号选择下一区间
criteria: Compute the midpoint of the current bracket.
Stop at an exact midpoint root, or choose the next sign-changing half-interval.

name: Sinusoidal Functions
originalDescription: 知道 y=Asin(ωx+φ) 中 A 影响振幅，ω 影响周期。
description: For y=A sin(omega*x+phi) with omega nonzero, the amplitude is |A|. When A is also nonzero, the least positive period is 2*pi/|omega|. If A=0 or omega=0, the function is constant, has zero oscillation amplitude, and has no least positive period.
originalCriteria: 能指出振幅是 |A|
能由 ω 说出周期与 2π 的关系
criteria: For omega nonzero, identify the amplitude as |A|.
For a nonconstant sinusoid, relate its least positive period to 2*pi/|omega|; distinguish the constant case.

name: Vector Collinearity Theorem
originalDescription: 知道非零向量 b 与 a 共线，当且仅当存在实数 λ 使 b=λa。
description: For a nonzero reference vector a, test whether b=lambda*a for a real scalar lambda. For two nonzero vectors this characterizes collinear directions. The zero vector is a scalar multiple but has no direction; do not divide by a zero reference vector.
originalCriteria: 能判断一个向量是否为另一个的实数倍
能求出这个倍数
criteria: 能判断一个向量是否为另一个的实数倍
能求出这个倍数

name: Vector Magnitudes and Angles
originalDescription: 能由坐标求模，并判断两个向量是否垂直。
description: Compute vector magnitude from coordinates. For two nonzero vectors, zero dot product is equivalent to perpendicular directions. The zero vector has no defined direction or included angle.
originalCriteria: 能用勾股定理求模
知道数量积为 0 时垂直
criteria: Use the Pythagorean formula to calculate magnitude.
For nonzero vectors, use a zero dot product to test perpendicularity.

name: Law of Cosines
originalDescription: 会用余弦定理求第三边的平方，已知两边及其夹角的余弦。
description: 会用余弦定理求第三边的平方，已知两边及其夹角的余弦。
originalCriteria: 能写出余弦定理
能在 cos 为 0、1 或 1/2 时算出第三边的平方
criteria: State c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab*cos(C) for two sides and their included angle.
Calculate the third-side square when the supplied included-angle cosine is 0 or 1/2. An included angle in a nondegenerate triangle cannot have cosine 1.

name: Angle of Inclination of a Line
originalDescription: 直线向上方向与 x 轴正方向所成的最小正角叫做倾斜角，范围是 0 度到 180 度。
description: The inclination of an unoriented line is its counterclockwise angle from the positive x-axis, chosen in [0,180) degrees. Horizontal lines have inclination 0 and vertical lines 90 degrees.
originalCriteria: 能说出倾斜角的范围
能区分倾斜角和直线与 x 轴的另一个夹角
criteria: 能说出倾斜角的范围
能区分倾斜角和直线与 x 轴的另一个夹角

name: Using slopes to determine parallelism and perpendicularity
originalDescription: 两条斜率都存在的直线：斜率相等则平行，斜率乘积为 −1 则垂直。
description: For two lines with finite slopes, equal slopes mean parallel or coincident lines; strict parallelism also requires distinctness. The product of slopes is -1 exactly when those two nonvertical lines are perpendicular. Treat vertical and horizontal lines separately.
originalCriteria: 能用斜率判断平行
能用斜率乘积判断垂直
criteria: 能用斜率判断平行
能用斜率乘积判断垂直

name: Relative positions of two circles
originalDescription: 设两圆半径为 r1、r2，圆心距为 d。d=r1+r2 外切，d=|r1−r2| 内切，介于两者之间则相交。
description: For circles of positive radii r1,r2 and center distance d: d=r1+r2 gives external tangency; 0<d=|r1-r2| gives internal tangency; |r1-r2|<d<r1+r2 gives two intersections. If d=0 and r1=r2 the circles coincide. Outside these ranges they have no common point.
originalCriteria: 能计算圆心距
能用圆心距和半径判断位置关系
criteria: 能计算圆心距
能用圆心距和半径判断位置关系

name: Definition of a Hyperbola
originalDescription: 平面内到两个定点的距离之差的绝对值等于常数（小于两定点间距离）的点的轨迹是双曲线。
description: A nondegenerate hyperbola is the locus of points whose absolute difference of distances to two distinct foci is a fixed positive constant strictly smaller than the focal separation. Zero difference gives the perpendicular bisector, not a hyperbola.
originalCriteria: 能说出双曲线用的是距离之差
知道常数要小于焦距
criteria: Identify the absolute difference of the two focal distances.
Require 0<constant<focal separation for a nondegenerate hyperbola.

name: Arithmetic Sequences and Linear Functions
originalDescription: 等差数列的通项 a_n=dn+(a1−d) 是 n 的一次函数，公差就是一次项系数。
description: An arithmetic sequence has a_n=d*n+(a1-d) on positive integer indices. For d nonzero this is the restriction of a nonconstant affine line with slope d; d=0 gives a constant sequence. Read the common difference from the coefficient of n.
originalCriteria: 能把通项写成一次函数
能从一次项系数读出公差
criteria: Write a_n=d*n+(a1-d) and distinguish the nonconstant linear-function case d!=0 from the constant case d=0.
Read the common difference from the coefficient of n.

name: Geometric sequences and exponential functions
originalDescription: 等比数列的通项 a_n=a1·q^(n−1) 是指数型的，底数是公比。
description: A geometric sequence under the consecutive-ratio definition has a_n=a1*q^(n-1), with a1 nonzero, q nonzero and positive integer indices. For q>0 and q!=1 it extends to a real exponential-type function; q=1 is constant. A negative q gives an alternating sequence without an ordinary real exponential extension to every real input.
originalCriteria: 能指出公比就是指数的底
能比较等比数列和指数函数的定义域
criteria: For q>0 and q!=1, identify q as the exponential base in the term formula.
Compare the positive-integer domain of the geometric sequence with the real domain of its exponential-type extension, and distinguish the q=1 and negative-q cases.

name: Conditions for Local Extrema
originalDescription: 导数为 0 是可导函数取极值的必要条件。两侧导数变号，才是极值的充分条件。
description: At a differentiable interior local extremum the derivative is zero; the converse is false. When the derivative has one sign throughout a left neighborhood and the opposite sign throughout a right neighborhood, its sign change is a sufficient local maximum/minimum test. This sufficient test need not describe every differentiable extremum.
originalCriteria: 能求导数为 0 的点
能用两侧符号区分极大和极小
criteria: 能求导数为 0 的点
能用两侧符号区分极大和极小

name: Extrema on a Closed Interval
originalDescription: 闭区间上的连续函数，最值在极值点或端点取得。比较这些点的函数值即可。
description: A continuous real function on a closed bounded interval attains its extrema. Compare relevant interior extrema and endpoints; when using derivatives to find candidates, also inspect points where the derivative does not exist. A derivative-zero list alone is insufficient for a merely continuous function.
originalCriteria: 能列出极值点和端点
能比较函数值得到最大或最小
criteria: 能列出极值点和端点
能比较函数值得到最大或最小

name: Conditional Probability
originalDescription: 在事件 B 已经发生的条件下事件 A 的概率记为 P(A|B)，等于 P(A∩B)/P(B)。
description: For events with P(B)>0, P(A|B)=P(A intersection B)/P(B). In a finite equally likely space this is the proportion of outcomes in B that also belong to A. The elementary ratio is undefined when P(B)=0.
originalCriteria: 能在缩小后的结果里计算条件概率
能说出条件概率的定义
criteria: 能在缩小后的结果里计算条件概率
能说出条件概率的定义

name: Multiplication Rule for Probability
originalDescription: P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B|A)。可以按事件发生的顺序把概率相乘。
description: When P(A)>0, P(A intersection B)=P(A)*P(B|A). Multiply in event order using the appropriate conditional probabilities. If P(A)=0, the intersection probability is zero directly; the elementary P(B|A) ratio is undefined.
originalCriteria: 能用乘法公式计算两个事件同时发生的概率
能按先后顺序写出条件概率
criteria: 能用乘法公式计算两个事件同时发生的概率
能按先后顺序写出条件概率

name: Conditional Probability and Independence
originalDescription: 若 P(B|A)=P(B)，则 A 发生不改变 B 的概率，A 与 B 相互独立。独立不是互斥。
description: When P(A)>0, A and B are independent exactly when P(B|A)=P(B). Independence means P(A intersection B)=P(A)*P(B), which also covers P(A)=0 without forming an undefined conditional ratio. Independence is different from mutual exclusivity.
originalCriteria: 能用条件概率判断独立
能区分独立和互斥
criteria: 能用条件概率判断独立
能区分独立和互斥

name: Sample correlation coefficient
originalDescription: 样本相关系数 r 用离差乘积来衡量线性相关的方向和强弱，取值在 −1 到 1 之间。
description: For paired samples with nonzero variation in both variables, the sample correlation r describes the direction and strength of linear association and lies in [-1,1]. Centered cross-products contribute to its calculation. If either variable is constant, r is undefined.
originalCriteria: 能计算很小数列的离差乘积和
知道 r 接近 1 或 −1 时线性相关强
criteria: 能计算很小数列的离差乘积和
知道 r 接近 1 或 −1 时线性相关强

name: Simple Linear Regression Model
originalDescription: 一元线性回归把响应变量写成解释变量的一次函数再加上随机误差。
description: Simple linear regression represents a response as a+b*x plus a random error. Identify explanatory and response variables, and calculate the fitted line value without the error term. The slope b may be zero.
originalCriteria: 能说出模型里有解释变量和响应变量
能在没有误差时由直线算出函数值
criteria: 能说出模型里有解释变量和响应变量
能在没有误差时由直线算出函数值

name: Least Squares Estimation of Regression Coefficients
originalDescription: 对点 (x_i,y_i)，斜率 b=(n∑xy−∑x∑y)/(n∑x²−(∑x)²)，截距 a=ȳ−b x̄。
description: For observations (x_i,y_i) with nonzero variation in x, the least-squares slope is b=(n*sum(x_i*y_i)-sum(x_i)*sum(y_i))/(n*sum(x_i^2)-(sum(x_i))^2), and intercept a=mean(y)-b*mean(x). If all x values coincide, the usual slope formula is undefined and the slope is not uniquely determined.
originalCriteria: 能对很少的点算出斜率
能随后算出截距
criteria: 能对很少的点算出斜率
能随后算出截距

name: The Idea Behind a Test of Independence
originalDescription: 独立性检验先假设两个分类变量独立，再看观测到的列联表是否偏离这个假设太远。
description: 独立性检验先假设两个分类变量独立，再看观测到的列联表是否偏离这个假设太远。
originalCriteria: 能说出先假设独立再看偏离
知道 ad−bc 为 0 时四格很均衡
criteria: Start from the independence hypothesis and assess how far the observed contingency table departs from it.
For a 2 by 2 table with positive margins, ad-bc=0 means the observed conditional proportions agree; it neither requires equal cell counts nor proves population independence.

name: The Test Statistic for a Test of Independence
originalDescription: 2×2 表可用 χ²=n(ad−bc)²/((a+b)(c+d)(a+c)(b+d))。数值越大，越倾向认为有关联。
description: For a 2 by 2 count table with positive row and column totals, Pearson chi-square is n*(ad-bc)^2/((a+b)*(c+d)*(a+c)*(b+d)). A larger statistic is stronger evidence against independence under the test assumptions. It depends on sample size and is not an association effect size; zero margins make this formula undefined.
originalCriteria: 能把四格人数代入这个公式
知道公式等于 0 时交叉乘积平衡
criteria: 能把四格人数代入这个公式
知道公式等于 0 时交叉乘积平衡

name: Addition Within 20 Without Regrouping
originalDescription: 会计算十几加几、十几加整十这类不进位的加法。
description: Add a single-digit number to a teen number from 11 through 19 without carrying, keeping the sum within 20. Add the units digits to the units digits. Adding a whole ten to a teen number is outside this node scope.
originalCriteria: 能算出不进位的十几加几
知道个位和个位相加
criteria: 能算出不进位的十几加几
知道个位和个位相加

name: Multiplying Decimals by Decimals
originalDescription: 会计算小数乘小数，积的小数位数等于两个因数小数位数的和。
description: Multiply decimals by multiplying their integer digit strings and initially placing the decimal point using the sum of the factors' decimal-place counts. Removing trailing zeros can reduce the number of decimal places in the final written result.
originalCriteria: 能算出小数乘小数的积
能根据两个因数的小数位数确定积的小数点
criteria: 能算出小数乘小数的积
能根据两个因数的小数位数确定积的小数点

name: Finding the Defective Item
originalDescription: 知道用天平找较重或较轻的次品时，每次尽量分成三份来称。
description: Among equally heavy normal items, exactly one exceptional item is known in advance to be heavier, or known in advance to be lighter. While more than one candidate remains, divide the candidates into three groups as nearly equal as possible, weigh two equal-size groups, and retain the group indicated by the balance outcome. Minimum guaranteed weighing counts here use this known-direction model; an unknown heavy-versus-light item requires a different analysis.
originalCriteria: 能说出每次要分成三份
能算出至少称几次
criteria: Plan a near-equal three-way candidate split in the known-heavy or known-light model, allowing an empty third group when necessary.
Find the minimum number of weighings that guarantees identification for the stated number of candidates under this model.

name: Introduction to sectors
originalDescription: 认识扇形是由圆心角的两条半径和一段弧围成的图形。
description: 认识扇形是由圆心角的两条半径和一段弧围成的图形。
originalCriteria: 能指出扇形的两条半径
能比较圆心角较大时扇形也较大
criteria: Identify the two radii bounding a circular sector.
Within the same circle or equal-radius circles, a larger central angle gives a larger sector area.
